art_direction: 深蓝背景上盛开一朵象牙牡丹，翠绿甲虫停在外瓣，花瓣层次细腻但中心清楚。
composition: one original focal subject, centered and readable within a circular avatar crop
creative_direction: Create a close portrait of one ivory peony with a tiny emerald beetle resting on the lower outer petal. The flower fills roughly two thirds of the square, seen from an oblique angle so its layered petals overlap like folded tissue. Use cool porcelain whites, faint lilac shadows, and a small warm center against an uninterrupted midnight blue ground. Render the beetle with a few precise green reflections and natural legs, keeping it secondary to the flower. Concentrate the finest petal edges around the center, allowing the outermost folds to become broader shapes. The composition should retain a clear circular flower mass rather than dissolve into a field of decorative blossoms.
style_inspiration: Original artwork from written art direction; prior conversation informs general design preferences, no prior image pixels reused or uploaded.
visual_review: passed: compressed preview inspected for clear original focal composition, requested medium and detail level, circular-crop readability, no unintended anatomy or rendering defects, no text or watermark
